show.title: Ripple Daily
show.subtitle: India's markets in under 10 minutes, every morning
show.description: Ripple Daily is a 7-10 minute morning briefing on the 10 stories moving Indian markets, from the Ripple news desk. Two hosts, SU and Pri: one hot topic in depth, then nine stories rapid-fire, each ending with the stocks in focus. In English, every day before the market opens. Voices are AI-generated with open-source Kokoro voices. This is news, not investment advice; the hosts are not SEBI-registered advisers.
show.author: Priyanshu Chandak
